user_prompt: Compare all-firm service with a specified non-firm tranche under the proposed price-trigger mechanism. Calculate curtailed MWh, event restart costs, lost business contribution net of avoided electricity, annual benefit, NPV and break-even annual avoided firm costs. Stress interruption duration and business contribution. Keep proposal status and synthetic customer assumptions explicit.

role_mandates.evidence_contract: Validate proposal status, dates, units, annual chronology and full curtailability. This is not regulatory eligibility review.
role_mandates.project_finance_analyst: Reconcile lost contribution excluding electricity against avoided electricity expense. Include restart, flexibility CAPEX and OPEX. Never infer tariff savings from the announcement.
role_mandates.energy_orchestrator: Only delegate evidence then finance; reject premature and unknown actions.

input_schema: case.json v1.0: synthetic USD; ISO HTTPS announcement with publication <= as_of and proposal_not_effective_rule status; constant-real year-end economics; 1..8760 ordered blocks of positive hours totalling 8760, finite price -10000..100000 USD/MWh; nonnegative costs and MW; nonfirm <= flexible <= total load; years integer 1..50, discount 0..1. validate_case enforces bounds.
evidence_requirements: Explicit final-tariff, nodal-price and customer-cost gaps
No realised benefit or legal compliance claim
handoffs: Operator supplies synthetic chronology and fully curtailable tranche
Evidence-approved isolated input to existing finance role
Human policy/engineering review of tariff, service contracts, actual controls and workload feasibility
output_contract: Input hash and proposed rule status
Period curtailed MWh and cash ledger
Contiguous event count and restart costs
Annual incremental benefit, NPV and break-even annual avoided firm cost in USD
Eligibility unknown; no dispatch authority; LLM measurements unknown
acceptance: Consecutive high-price blocks count one event
Lost contribution excludes electricity to avoid double counting
No external controls, contracts, trades, purchases or contacts
